newsitem.title: DUBAI: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Feb 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - United Arab Emirates - Feb 5.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the United Arab Emirates press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Central Bank to cover small UAE depositors in the failed Bank of Credit and Commerce International (BCCI).
- Dubai's re-exports surge over 40 percent in first eight months of 1996.
- Adnoc awards consultancy contract for petrochemical project.
- The economy ministry has proposed to the industry ministry that it should resume issuing trade licences for textile and garment manufacturing. The ministry suspended issuing new licences in 1994.
